import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int U = 1 << 29;
    static final int LIM = 500;

    static class Link {
        int u, v, cap, flow;
        Link(int u, int v, int cap, int flow) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] free_spots = new boolean[11][11];
    static List<Integer>[] g = new List[LIM];
    static List<Link> el = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] level_ = new int[LIM];
    static int[] idx = new int[LIM];
    static int grid_dim, ex_r, ex_c, max_time;
    static int[][] step_cnt = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] flow_cap = new int[11][11];

    static int shortest_path(int sr, int sc, int tr, int tc) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{0, sr, sc});
        int[][] d = new int[11][11];
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 11; ++j)
                d[i][j] = U;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int dist = q.peek()[0];
            int r = q.peek()[1];
            int c = q.peek()[2];
            q.poll();
            d[r][c] = dist;
            if (r > 0 && free_spots[r-1][c]) {
                int nr = r - 1, nc = c;
                if (d[nr][nc] > dist + 1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nr == tr && nc == tc && step_cnt[nr][nc] >= dist + 1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nr == tr && nc == tc) && step_cnt[nr][nc] > dist + 1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2) q.offer(new int[]{dist + 1, nr, nc});
                }
            }
            if (c > 0 && free_spots[r][c-1]) {
                int nr = r, nc = c - 1;
                if (d[nr][nc] > dist + 1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nr == tr && nc == tc && step_cnt[nr][nc] >= dist + 1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nr == tr && nc == tc) && step_cnt[nr][nc] > dist + 1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2) q.offer(new int[]{dist + 1, nr, nc});
                }
            }
            if (r < grid_dim-1 && free_spots[r+1][c]) {
                int nr = r + 1, nc = c;
                if (d[nr][nc] > dist + 1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nr == tr && nc == tc && step_cnt[nr][nc] >= dist + 1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nr == tr && nc == tc) && step_cnt[nr][nc] > dist + 1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2) q.offer(new int[]{dist + 1, nr, nc});
                }
            }
            if (c < grid_dim-1 && free_spots[r][c+1]) {
                int nr = r, nc = c + 1;
                if (d[nr][nc] > dist + 1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nr == tr && nc == tc && step_cnt[nr][nc] >= dist + 1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nr == tr && nc == tc) && step_cnt[nr][nc] > dist + 1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2) q.offer(new int[]{dist + 1, nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
        return d[tr][tc];
    }

    static void link_nodes(int a, int b, int cap) {
        el.add(new Link(a, b, cap, 0));
        el.add(new Link(b, a, 0, 0));
        g[a].add(el.size() - 2);
        g[b].add(el.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean build_level_graph() {
        Arrays.fill(level_, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(0);
        level_[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && level_[grid_dim * grid_dim * 2 + 1] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int eid : g[u]) {
                int v = el.get(eid).v;
                if (level_[v] == -1 && el.get(eid).flow < el.get(eid).cap) {
                    level_[v] = level_[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level_[grid_dim * grid_dim * 2 + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int push_flow(int u, int limit) {
        if (limit == 0) return 0;
        if (u == grid_dim * grid_dim * 2 + 1) return limit;
        for (; idx[u] < g[u].size(); ++idx[u]) {
            int eid = g[u].get(idx[u]);
            int v = el.get(eid).v;
            if (level_[v] != level_[u] + 1) continue;
            int delta = push_flow(v, Math.min(limit, el.get(eid).cap - el.get(eid).flow));
            if (delta != 0) {
                el.get(eid).flow += delta;
                el.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= delta;
                return delta;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic_algo() {
        int res = 0;
        while (build_level_graph()) {
            Arrays.fill(idx, 0);
            int x;
            while ((x = push_flow(0, U)) > 0) res += x;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        grid_dim = sc.nextInt();
        max_time = sc.nextInt();
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        char val;
        int node_counter = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 11; ++j)
                free_spots[i][j] = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < LIM; ++i)
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_dim; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_dim; ++j) {
                val = sc.next().charAt(0);
                step_cnt[i][j] = max_time;
                if (val == 'Z') {
                    ex_r = i;
                    ex_c = j;
                    free_spots[i][j] = false;
                } else if (val == 'Y') {
                    free_spots[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    free_spots[i][j] = true;
                }
                link_nodes(0, node_counter++, (val == 'Z' || val == 'Y') ? 0 : val - '0');
            }
        }
        node_counter = grid_dim * grid_dim + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_dim; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_dim; ++j) {
                val = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (val >= '0' && val <= '9') flow_cap[i][j] = val - '0';
                link_nodes(node_counter++, grid_dim * grid_dim * 2 + 1, (val == 'Z' || val == 'Y') ? 0 : val - '0');
            }
        }
        q.offer(new int[]{0, ex_r, ex_c});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int d = q.peek()[0];
            int r = q.peek()[1];
            int c = q.peek()[2];
            q.poll();
            step_cnt[r][c] = d;
            if (r > 0 && d + 1 < step_cnt[r - 1][c] && free_spots[r - 1][c])
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r - 1, c});
            if (c > 0 && d + 1 < step_cnt[r][c - 1] && free_spots[r][c - 1])
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r, c - 1});
            if (r < grid_dim - 1 && d + 1 < step_cnt[r + 1][c] && free_spots[r + 1][c])
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r + 1, c});
            if (c < grid_dim - 1 && d + 1 < step_cnt[r][c + 1] && free_spots[r][c + 1])
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r, c + 1});
        }
        int node_id = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_dim; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_dim; ++j) {
                int sink_id = grid_dim * grid_dim;
                ++node_id;
                for (int x = 0; x < grid_dim; ++x) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < grid_dim; ++y) {
                        ++sink_id;
                        if (free_spots[i][j] && free_spots[x][y] && shortest_path(i, j, x, y) <= max_time)
                            link_nodes(node_id, sink_id, U);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinic_algo());
    }
}
